speaker: Petunia

speaker: Harry

speaker: Dumbledore

speaker: Dumbledore
note: Affectionate seniority.

speaker: Hagrid

note: Hagrid has no respect for the Dursleys and Telugu lets him say so in one syllable.

speaker: Snape
note: Teacher-to-student నువ్వు is unremarkable. His contempt has to come from vocabulary and clipped verb forms — do not reach for అది or similar.
